Bassist Buster Williams was born on April 17, 1942 in Camden, New Jersey. He possesses one of the most distinctive sounds in all of jazz and has appeared as a sideman on a lengthy list of notable recordings. He currently tours and records with his own group, “Something More.”
Buster was interviewed in New York City on January 6, 2002 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.

My name is Monk Rowe and we are in Manhattan and I’ve very pleased to have bassist Buster Williams with me for the Hamilton College Jazz Archive. Thank you for coming today. It looks like your group “Something More” has a couple of busy months coming up.
Oh yeah, you’ve been to the web site.
